name: Tomas Tobé - Après le § 42 - Am 19
title: REPORT on the findings and recommendations of the Special Committee on the European Democracy Shield
part_text: 42a. Highlights that digital public goods fundamentally contribute to the integrity of the EU’s knowledge infrastructure while at the same time empowering citizens, including young people, minorities and marginalised groups, to participate meaningfully in democratic life; calls on the Commission to acknowledge this aspect and promote the use of digital public goods as building blocks for achieving a sovereign and resilient EU digital infrastructure;
